name: gplanchat/durable
description: PHP library for durable execution: workflows, activities, event journal, and transports (HttpKernel integration lives in the bundle).

suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Required by the shipped test helpers (Testing\DurableTestCase, Testing\WorkflowTestEnvironment)
suggest.gplanchat/durable-phpstan: Optional PHPStan extension: resolves ActivityStub and ChildWorkflowStub calls from their typed contract (DUR038)
suggest.gplanchat/durable-bridge-dbal: SQL backend: durable execution on one database, no cluster (DUR030)
